description: The declared Accommodation Supplement scenario set (method card amendment MC3a): entitlement-tier scenarios S0-S5 branch from the shared AS version after calibration; calibration-tier variants V1-V3 branch before calibration and re-run it. Each non-central scenario changes exactly one knob from the central defaults. Bands are the minimum, S0 and the maximum of each gap table across every scenario, and each band bound names the scenario that set it.
status: awaiting D1 (MC3a, MC8-MC12); S4's factor awaits Chronicle evidence

knob_domains.rent_stock_factor: a positive number; null only while status says it awaits evidence

scenarios.description: reg 17 superannuitant treatment, the alternative to the MC11 default. The override is the engine-calling bridge, which rewrites the base rate; a non-engine override would hand-compute policy (as_rate_bridge.json superannuitant_units)

keying_note: Charter C2 (adding a scenario re-keys only the bands and package nodes) holds only if each scenario's graph nodes carry that scenario's own resolved knobs and a digest of its own entry, not this file's SHA-256.
